articles.title: Hyderabad SI Booked After Letting 6-Year-Old Granddaughter Drive Car on Busy Road
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A Hyderabad Police Sub-Inspector has been booked after allegedly allowing his six-and-a-half-year-old granddaughter to drive a car on a busy public road on the outskirts of the city, putting her life and the safety of other road users at risk.

body.html:
A Hyderabad Police Sub-Inspector has been booked after allegedly allowing his six-and-a-half-year-old granddaughter to drive a car on a busy public road on the outskirts of the city, putting her life and the safety of other road users at risk.

According to police, the incident occurred on July 11. The officer, identified as Pujari Thirupathi, allegedly permitted the child to drive his Maruti Swift while he sat in the front passenger seat with one hand on the steering wheel.

A video of the incident, which has surfaced on social media, shows the young girl slowly driving the car on a public road as several vehicles trail behind, unable to overtake due to the vehicle's slow speed. Local residents eventually stopped the car and confronted the officer over allowing the minor to drive.

Following the incident, Hyderabad Police registered a case against the Sub-Inspector under Section 125 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) for negligent conduct endangering human life and personal safety, along with relevant provisions of the Motor Vehicles Act for permitting a minor to drive.

Police said the case has been registered and further investigation is underway.

#Hyderabad #Telangana #RoadSafety #ViralVideo

body.html:
Caught on Camera: High drama unfolded at the Pangat Hotel in Rewa, Madhya Pradesh, when a woman tracked down her husband and caught him red-handed with another woman in room 108.

articles.title: Wife Catches Husband With Another Woman in Rewa Hotel, Slaps Him as Video Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic confrontation unfolded at a hotel in Madhya Pradesh's Rewa after a woman allegedly found her husband with another woman, leading to a heated argument and scuffle. A video of the incident has since gone viral on social media.

body.html:
A dramatic confrontation unfolded at a hotel in Madhya Pradesh's Rewa after a woman allegedly found her husband with another woman, leading to a heated argument and scuffle. A video of the incident has since gone viral on social media.

According to reports, Ranu Pandey and her husband, Prakash Singh Chauhan, both from Sidhi district, had a court marriage on July 3, 2025. Ranu alleged that she learned through a friend that her husband was staying at Pangat Hotel near the new bus stand with another woman.

After searching the hotel, she located Room No. 108. When the door was opened, she allegedly found her husband inside with a young woman and immediately confronted him. The viral video shows Ranu repeatedly slapping Prakash while asking, "Have you divorced me?"

The woman accompanying Prakash allegedly claimed that she was married to him and accused him of hiding his earlier marriage. Prakash, meanwhile, claimed that the woman had brought him to the hotel against his will, a claim both women disputed.

According to Ranu, her husband had been avoiding her for months despite their marriage. She alleged that he was secretly involved with another woman and questioned why he married her if he intended to seek a divorce.

During the confrontation, Prakash reportedly told her that he wanted to live with his new partner and seek a divorce. Ranu then allegedly took him to the Civil Lines Police Station after the altercation.

Police said they received information about the dispute and brought both parties to the police station. Station House Officer Vijay Singh said the matter is under investigation and appropriate legal action will be taken based on the complaint and evidence.

Police are also examining allegations that a fake Aadhaar card with an altered surname was used to register the woman accompanying Prakash at the hotel.

#MadhyaPradesh #Rewa #ViralVideo #HotelDrama #MarriageDispute

articles.title: Man Drags Estranged Wife by Hair, Beats Her in Broad Daylight; Arrested After CCTV Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident of alleged domestic violence was caught on CCTV in Gujarat's Surat, where a man allegedly stopped his estranged wife's scooter in the middle of a busy road, dragged her by the hair and brutally assaulted her in broad daylight.

body.html:
A shocking incident of alleged domestic violence was caught on CCTV in Gujarat's Surat, where a man allegedly stopped his estranged wife's scooter in the middle of a busy road, dragged her by the hair and brutally assaulted her in broad daylight. The accused was arrested hours after the victim lodged a complaint.

The incident took place on Saturday morning near Pragati IT Park on Mota Varachha Road. According to police, the accused, identified as 46-year-old Pravinbhai Amarshibhai Golkiya, intercepted his wife's scooter while she was returning home after dropping their daughter at school.

Police said the couple had been living separately since 2019 due to marital disputes, and their case is pending before a family court.

The accused allegedly got out of his car, abused his wife, grabbed her by the hair, dragged her across the road and repeatedly punched and kicked her. The woman alleged that the accused's female companion, who was in the car, also slapped her during the assault.

The CCTV footage, now viral on social media, shows passersby gathering and intervening to stop the attack. Before fleeing, the accused allegedly threatened to kill his estranged wife.

The injured woman called the 112 police helpline and was later taken to Smimer Hospital by ambulance for treatment. After receiving first aid, she lodged a complaint at Utran Police Station.

Based on her complaint, police registered a case against Pravinbhai Golkiya and his female companion under relevant provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). CCTV footage has been seized, and further investigation is underway.

Police said the couple have two daughters, with one living with the mother and the other with the father. Authorities said the assault followed an unexpected encounter between the estranged couple.

#Surat #Gujarat #DomesticViolence #CCTV #CrimeNews

articles.title: Woman Alleges Harassment on KSRTC Bus Near Bengaluru, Accused Forced Off After Passengers Intervene
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A case of alleged sexual harassment was reported aboard a KSRTC bus travelling towards Nelamangala on the outskirts of Bengaluru.

body.html:
A case of alleged sexual harassment was reported aboard a KSRTC bus travelling towards Nelamangala on the outskirts of Bengaluru.

According to a passenger who claimed to have witnessed the incident, it occurred between 7:00 pm and 8:00 pm when a man wearing a pink shirt allegedly repeatedly touched a young woman, dressed in a white top, inappropriately during the journey.

The woman was reportedly left visibly distressed and was seen silently crying. A fellow passenger noticed her condition and asked if she was alright, following which the woman allegedly revealed that the man had been touching her inappropriately.

Another woman passenger then intervened, asked the driver to stop the bus, and confronted the accused. Several passengers came forward in support of the woman and informed the bus conductor about the alleged harassment.

According to the eyewitness, the woman slapped the accused during the confrontation. The conductor reportedly collected the man's ticket, and he was made to get off the bus near the Nelamangala Toll Plaza.

The incident was reported by a passenger who claimed to have witnessed the entire episode. The allegations have not been independently verified, and it is unclear whether a formal police complaint has been filed.

Authorities have not yet issued an official statement, and no police case has been confirmed so far.

#Bengaluru #KSRTC #SexualHarassment #WomenSafety

articles.title: 5 Pilgrims Killed, 3 Critical After SUV Crashes Into Heavy Vehicle on Rajasthan Highway
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Five pilgrims were killed and three others remain in critical condition after their SUV collided with an unidentified heavy vehicle on the Jodhpur National Highway in Rajasthan's Balotra district late on Sunday night.

body.html:
Five pilgrims were killed and three others remain in critical condition after their SUV collided with an unidentified heavy vehicle on the Jodhpur National Highway in Rajasthan's Balotra district late on Sunday night.

According to police, eight people from Kanod village in Baytu were returning from the Padasla Bhomiaji temple in Osian when the accident occurred near Bhandiyawas-Kudi around midnight. The impact left the SUV mangled, trapping several occupants inside.

Local residents rushed to the scene and, along with rescue teams, pulled the victims from the wreckage before they were shifted to hospital. Two young men died at the spot, while another succumbed to injuries at Nahata District Hospital in Balotra. Five critically injured victims were referred to Jodhpur, where two more later died during treatment, taking the death toll to five.

The deceased have been identified as Kishan, Bhavesh, Revant Marudhar, Swaroop Godara and Bharat Godara. The three surviving victims are undergoing treatment in Jodhpur and remain in critical condition.

Police have launched a search for the unidentified heavy vehicle involved in the crash. The exact cause of the accident is under investigation, and further action will be be taken after the post-mortem examination and completion of the investigation.

The incident has once again highlighted concerns over road safety on the Jodhpur–Balotra highway, particularly involving heavy vehicles and late-night pilgrim travel.

#Rajasthan #Balotra #RoadAccident #Pilgrims #Jodhpur

articles.title: Speeding Mercedes Mows Down 2 Outside Chandigarh Nightclub, Driver Flees
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Two youths were seriously injured after a speeding Mercedes allegedly hit them outside a nightclub in Sector 26, Chandigarh, on Saturday evening.

body.html:
Two youths were seriously injured after a speeding Mercedes allegedly hit them outside a nightclub in Sector 26, Chandigarh, on Saturday evening. The driver allegedly fled the scene with the vehicle, but police said the accused has since been identified and legal action is being initiated.

The injured, Amjad from Bapu Dham Colony in Sector 26 and Alliance Preet from Sector 44, were rushed to Government Medical College and Hospital (GMCH), Sector 32, where they are undergoing treatment.

According to the preliminary investigation, the two had visited a nightclub and were leaving when the speeding Mercedes allegedly rammed into them. The impact threw both onto the road, causing serious injuries. The driver allegedly did not stop after the collision and fled.

A video of the incident, which surfaced on social media on Sunday, has gone viral. The footage appears to show the Mercedes being driven at high speed outside the nightclub before reversing and striking one of the victims, after which it leaves the spot. The authenticity of the video has not been independently verified.

Sector 26 police reached the spot after receiving information and shifted the injured to the hospital. Investigators have seized CCTV footage from the area to reconstruct the sequence of events.

Inspector Sarita Roy, holding additional charge as SHO of Sector 26 Police Station, said the driver has been identified and action is being taken in accordance with the law. The investigation is ongoing.

#Chandigarh #Mercedes #HitAndRun #RoadAccident #CrimeNews

articles.title: 3 Women Pilgrims Killed, 4 Critical After Truck Ploughs Into Ashadhi Wari Procession in Pune
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Three women pilgrims participating in the Ashadhi Wari were killed and four others were critically injured after a truck rammed into a group of Warkaris on Saswad–Jejuri Road in Maharashtra's Pune district in the early hours of Monday.

body.html:
Three women pilgrims participating in the Ashadhi Wari were killed and four others were critically injured after a truck rammed into a group of Warkaris on Saswad–Jejuri Road in Maharashtra's Pune district in the early hours of Monday.

According to Pune Rural Police, the accident occurred near the Belsar toll plaza, around 500 metres from Jejuri town in Purandar taluka. The truck, carrying pilgrims from Nanded district, allegedly lost control at high speed and ran over another group of Warkaris from Kasbedigraj in Sangli district who were walking towards Pandharpur.

The injured women were rushed to a hospital in Jejuri, where they are undergoing treatment. Police have launched an investigation, and preliminary findings suggest the driver lost control of the vehicle before crashing into the procession.

The annual Ashadhi Wari began with the departure of Sant Tukaram Maharaj's Palkhi from Dehu on July 7 and Sant Dnyaneshwar Maharaj's Palkhi from Alandi on July 8. The two processions are scheduled to reach Pandharpur on July 24, ahead of the Ashadhi Ekadashi celebrations on July 25.

#Pune #AshadhiWari #Pandharpur #RoadAccident #Maharashtra

articles.title: Drunk DCM Driver Drags Bike for 2 Km After Hitting Rider, Major CNG Disaster Averted
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major tragedy was narrowly averted in Lucknow after a DCM truck loaded with CNG gas cylinders allegedly hit a motorcyclist and dragged his bike for nearly two kilometres before being stopped by alert traffic police.

body.html:
A major tragedy was narrowly averted in Lucknow after a DCM truck loaded with CNG gas cylinders allegedly hit a motorcyclist and dragged his bike for nearly two kilometres before being stopped by alert traffic police.

The incident occurred around 10 pm on Saturday near the Scooter India intersection on Kanpur Road. According to police, Shivansh Mishra, a resident of Banthra, had stopped to drink water when the DCM allegedly rammed into his motorcycle. While Mishra escaped by falling to the roadside, his bike became lodged beneath the front of the truck.

Despite the collision, the driver allegedly continued driving, dragging the motorcycle for around two kilometres. Eyewitnesses said sparks continuously flew from the bike, raising fears of a major explosion as the truck was carrying a large consignment of CNG cylinders.

Krishnanagar Traffic Police, who were following the vehicle, repeatedly signalled the driver to stop. When he ignored the warnings, officers overtook the truck near Daroga Kheda and safely brought it to a halt, preventing a potentially catastrophic accident.

Police said the driver, identified as Sajjan, a resident of Unnao district, was allegedly under the influence of alcohol. He was taken into custody along with the vehicle and handed over to Sarojini Nagar Police.

A case has been registered based on Shivansh Mishra's complaint, and further investigation is underway.
